mods.name: Enderman's Null
mods.description: Null warriors from Unstable SMP lore: summon an army with the Totem of Null and command it with the Banner of Null.

releases.notes:
## 1.2
- Ranks from the lore: Soldier, General (every 10th warrior) and a single Commander per totem.
- Commander modes: Lead (mace, blinks above targets and smashes down), Survey (invisible, highlights enemies only for you), Protect (protects youa and takes a would-be fatal blow for you before a totem pops).
- The commander is independent from the army: the first summon costs 15 levels, then he can be toggled on and off anywhere for free. If he dies, the next summon costs levels again.
- New formations: Line and Column. New orders: Follow cursor (up to 100 blocks) and the Pacifist behavior (takes damage, never fights back).
- Player-like movement: sprint and occasional bunny hops.
- Fixed Call Null losing warriors from unloaded chunks.
- Armor and weapons got Unbreaking 3 and Mending.
- Redesigned radial menu: framed panels and a ring.
- Config file: config/endermans-null.json.

> **Known bugs:**
> 
> 1. Holding several Totems of Null might cause unexpected stuff to happen.
>

mods.name: Enderman's Null
mods.description: Null warriors from Unstable SMP lore: summon an army with the Totem of Null and command it with the Banner of Null.

releases.notes:
## 1.1 (first release)
- Null Warrior mob with enchanted netherite gear, random names and regeneration.
- Totem of Null summoning ritual and totem binding: transferring the totem transfers the army, losing it destroys the army.
- Banner of Null with a radial menu: formations (circle, square, wedge), behaviors (passive, neutral, aggressive, raid), follow, hold, wander, army distance.
- "Call Null": ender pearls fall where you look and the army teleports there.
- Standing banner: the army guards the point, only the owner can take it back.
- Army saved between sessions, `/null` commands and `/null debug` for admins.
- English and Russian translations.

> **Known bugs:**
> 
> 1. Part of warriors don't tp after "Call Null".
> 
> 2. Holding several Totems of null might cause unexpected stuff to happen. 
>
